definitions.explanation: The school that is speaking or writing — used by a school about itself in official documents, websites, and announcements.
The principal campus of a school that also operates one or more branch campuses ({分校|ぶんこう}).

examples.japanese: {本校|ほんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧。
{本校|ほんこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}します→着用する：26849_chakuyousuru⟧。
examples.english: At our school, uniforms are worn.

examples.japanese: {本校|ほんこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方々|かたがた}→方々：02778_katagata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支|ささ}えられて→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧⟦{百年|ひゃくねん}→百年：28401_hyakunen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えました→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: Supported by the local community, our school has reached its hundredth year.
The main campus is near the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{分校|ぶんこう}→分校：30457_bunkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{本校|ほんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: From next year, the branch-campus students will attend the main campus too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分校|ぶんこう}→分校：30457_bunkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{閉|と}じられ→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧、{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{本校|ほんこう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: The branch school up in the mountains was closed, and the children now commute to the main campus by bus every day.

notes:
Composed of {本|ほん} (main, this) + {校|こう} (school). Which sense applies depends on who is speaking: a school describing itself means sense 1; a contrast with ⟦{分校|ぶんこう}→分校：30457_bunkou⟧ means sense 2.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本校|ほんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧: students of this school
- {本校|ほんこう}⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧: this school's own initiative
- {本校|ほんこう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分校|ぶんこう}→分校：30457_bunkou⟧: the main campus and the branch campus
- {本校|ほんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to attend the main campus

REGISTER:
Sense 1 belongs to formal institutional writing — school websites, printed notices, principals' greetings. A student talking about their own school would say {うちの学校|うちのがっこう} instead.
